title: The cycle's gate step still ends with no result
what: When the cycle's gate agent ends without its structured result, the change stops at 'gate' and nobody finds out whether the gate ran. Make the gate step robust: the gate runs detached with its log in the worktree, and the step reads the committed gate log (.relay/checks/<sha>.gate.log) for the head instead of trusting the agent's reply; an agent that ends with no result while a gate log for the head exists reports that log, and with no log the step reruns the gate once before stopping.
why: Same failure as the item a-gate-waited-on-by-a-runner-dies-at-its-turn-li, closed 25 Oct, now back: 29 Oct the gate step of wt/type-check-subfolders-and-cap-module-siz (head 0311f194) ended with 'subagent completed without calling StructuredOutput (after in-conversation nudge)', left no gate log, and no gate process was running; the front had to restart the change by hand. Machine load was about 35 on 12 cores with 6 lanes. Repeats under parallel load (MEDIUM by the waste principle). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: 29 Oct, cycle run wf_21bb938f-13f: the gate step for head 0311f194 returned no result and no .relay/checks/0311f194*.gate.log exists; the cycle stopped at 'gate'.
pass_cases: A gate agent that ends without a result while the head's gate log exists: the step reports that log's exit.
With no gate log for the head, the step runs the gate once more instead of stopping.
